Results.ReviewText: This is our 2nd Q series Weber grill. We wore out the old one using it at home and for tailgating- love it!!!
Results.Title: Love this Portable Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have both a full size Weber grill and this smaller Q1200.  Attaching the tank or the bottle is a real pain.  Have jammed my finger more than once. Really poor design.
Results.Title: Attaching propane bottle is a pest

Results.ReviewText: Everything comes outstanding, food definitely tastes great and its so easily to clean. It always looks like the day I got it.
Results.Title: Best grill ever

Results.ReviewText: Très efficace. Solide et bien fait. Un peu lourd. Très bon achat.
Results.Title: Un vrai bon choix.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill and high quality build.   Size is perfect for two people.  Have cooked burgers, chicken, pork tenderloin, and steak.  The grill marks are great and flavor is good.  But, it is not as good of flavor as a charcoal grill.  (I also own an Weber charcoal).  Indirect cooking is also a little complicated.
Results.Title: Q is a high quality portable grill.

Results.ReviewText: Wanted a smaller quantity bbq for camping. Coated cast iron grates are wonderful. Heat is evenly distributed, and the high temperature is plenty hot, and low is good for slow cooking.
Results.Title: Great camping accessory

Results.ReviewText: Compact and useful for 1-6 meals at a time. Not a great variety of cooking options but that means less can go wrong. Rapid cleanup and the throwaway foul drip dishes are outstanding. We keep ours with the stand at our small vacation home. The price and durability of this unit makes it an easy choice for us.
Results.Title: Well Designed for Occasional Use

Results.ReviewText: Just an average grill, not a typical Weber.  For the money, it seems a bit overpriced.  The "guts" are decent, but the grilling surface seems cheaply made.
Results.Title: Eh

Results.ReviewText: I have a large weber grill, but often cook just 1 steak or a couple burgers. Kind of a waste. Bought this grill for those situations, and it's perfect. Also took it to a tailgate once.
Results.Title: Just the right size

Results.ReviewText: Love this little guy. Used to have a larger, normal sized stationary grill with 20 lb propane tank. Wasted a lot of gas preheating space I didn't even use. This thing heats up quick gets hotter than my old one. I can throw a steak on at 500-550 degrees. Cleans easy and only need the 1 lb propane bottles. I've grilled steaks, chicken, hot dogs and burgers, probably 6-7 times now and I am still on the same propane bottle. Not heating space I don't use. Food seems juicier too. Bought the portable stand to put it on. I set a time after to cover it after 45 minutes when it's cooled down. Love how it folds down and I put some utensils and a can of fire retardant under the lid covered.
Results.Title: Lot of power for the size

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill to be used with our new RV. I liked this table top model we can use on a table or with a small metal table we bought to be used with it. Even took this on a car trip of 8 days. We ate ribeye steaks in parks and saved a lot of money. The grill heats up fast and does a great job. 100% happy with this grill.
Results.Title: Great packable grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve only had this BBQ for a few months and only use it for camping and outings.  But, the Weber 1200 Q is a little under powered…Takes time to get to full heat..It would be a five star if it had more BTU’S
Results.Title: Adequate

Results.ReviewText: Very nice little grill. Used for camping and boating. Nice grates, heats up fast and cleans up well. I ended up using quick connect fittings to be able to use either the main LP system on a camper or the 1lb tanks.
Results.Title: Nice little grill

Results.ReviewText: Excellent quality grill. Love it. Typical of what you would expect from Weber!
Results.Title: Excellent buy

Results.ReviewText: For the price this is an amazing bbq. Cooks evenly. Works great in winter months
Results.Title: Great small bbq

Results.ReviewText:
It is just my wife and I most of the time so we do not need a large grill. Large grills use up (waste) a lot of gas when cooking for a couple people. Our large grill would go through a tank a gas a month, but a tank of gas has lasted over 6 months with daily use.

Excellent price, saves gas, great design and from a long time reputable company to get future replacement parts.

Very happy with this purchase!
Results.Title: Great Little Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Absolutely love the Q1200. Temperature control is great. The thermometer seems accurate. Porcelain grates cleaned easily. 
Only wish that it had lid latch to secure the lid while transporting.
Results.Title: Weber Q1200 Blue

Results.ReviewText: Wonderful, travel size grill and works great. I would recommend it.
Results.Title: Travel size grill

Results.ReviewText: J'aime beaucoup sa forme. Il va bien sur mon balcon qui est petit. Il a une bonne performance de cuisson
Results.Title: Très beau modèle

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill to save some weight and space in our rv. It is much easier to get in and out of the storage bay than what we had previously.  This grill is perfect for our needs! Plenty of grill space for just the 2 of us. It seems to be well made and cleans up easily . Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a nice grill!
Results.Title: Perfect grill for our needs!

Results.ReviewText: It’s awesome. Easy to set up and start cooking fast.  Heats up fast too. Perfect for traveling, tailgating, camping etc. We love it
Results.Title: Awesome little BBQ machine

Results.ReviewText: Great little BBQ - lightweight and easy to pack and unpack. We use it when camping; we crafted a little base to cushion the propane tank while traveling since it hangs free from the connection point. Feels strong, but RVs are bounced around quite a bit.
Results.Title: Weber Q1200 - Makes BBQing Simple

Results.ReviewText: I replaced my big bbq a month ago with this table to Weber and I absolutely love it.  So easy to use and clean and cooks evenly.  Would highly recommend this bbq, especially if you are new to bbqing and/or live in a condo.
Results.Title: Love my Weber

Very good bar b que it works well

Great for the three of us

Results.ReviewText: Heats quick. Great little grill for small items. Done individual ribs, burgers, chops, steak.
Results.Title: Great small grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this to replace another brand that wasn't working very well. We use it when we're on the road in our 5th wheel. So far it has performed very well.
Results.Title: Great portable grill

Results.ReviewText: A little bulkier than my previous go everywhere but worth it! Cooks great.i gave value a 4 as I was lucky to purchase on sale.
Results.Title: Satisfied

Results.ReviewText: This unit works great, and is very easy to clean up. I only wish I had a flat section.
Results.Title: G did u

Results.ReviewText: We have one in our summer home & like it so much we purchased one to use in place of our larger Weber grill.
Results.Title: Our 2nd grill

Results.ReviewText:
Had my Q3200 for over a month now. Before grilling we wanted to change the color of the top as it was scratched and looked tired. Buying a new top was certainly  an option but we decided to spray with a high heat paint, aged copper. Turned out great.
Now for the serious business. This grill is to die for. Heavy top and bottom retain heat very well, the porcelain covered cast iron grates are a wonder to cook on. Keeping them clean is a breeze. I spray mine with a mixture of canola and flax oil after cleaning them a brush and paper towel.
Before cooking I spray with canola oil and rub it in. Preheating is a must and a breeze. I use natural gas so it takes a little longer to get to temp as NG burns lower than propane.
The burner setup is great. One straight down the middle from east to west. The main burner encircles the middle one. This makes it perfect for reverse searing.
All in all we loved it so much we went out and bought a new Q1200 for our trailer. Same perfection just smaller.
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill.  Heats up quick.  Would recommend to anyone that needs a small RV grill.
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText:
I'm quite pleased with my new Q1200. I've stuck to basic recipes from various websites. 
It would be a 5 star review except I can't tell if it's lit. Practice I guess.
Results.Title: Upgrade from a sandwich diet

Results.ReviewText: Je suis contente de ce bbq.il est facile a utiliser et très compact.facilw d entretien. Bref je l aime beaucoup.
Results.Title: Bbq

Results.ReviewText: This is a replacement for my old Q120 grill. I was ready for a newer version. I was happy with my old Q120, and this new Q1200 is just as good plus has a split cast iron grate. That isn't a big deal, but does make it a bit easier to remove the grates for cleaning. The porcelain coating is also a nice feature and makes it a bit easier to clean the grates.
Results.Title: The usual great grill

Results.ReviewText: I love the grill, however there is one major problem. I was unable to connect a 1 lb propane bottle due to the cramped area where it connects. This was not a major issue for me since I use shoes with a large tank but a major problem for someone trying to use a 1 lb bottle.
Results.Title: My new bbq…

Results.ReviewText: Had the 3200 model for years…replaced with Q1200.  Very pleased with new unit except I would like more heat!  Max is 410 deg on a warm and windless day
Results.Title: Very well designed and constructed

Results.ReviewText: Love my WeberQ 1200 grill. Gauge on lid allowed me to cook at just the right temperature. Igniter switch fired up the grill with ease. Easily cleaned. Love the folding tables.
Results.Title: Love my WeberQ

Results.ReviewText: I love my little grill.  I haven't grilled since my husband passed and with this little one it's so easy to put together and start using.
Results.Title: Q 1200
